scope: Actual protected cmd/webmux processes and browser enrollment; isolated homes and process-local Linux fixture certificate trust. Not installed-service, OS trust or real-agent/MAC acceptance.
checks: actual Linux application discovers macOS HTTPS application without enrolling it
human browser configures the discovered HTTPS endpoint and explicitly verifies node/account identity
actual receiver restart and changed port migrate in the controller background without an open browser
actual controller restart retains verified peer identity and migrated endpoint
departed receiver expires from discovery while its verified configured peer remains retained and unreachable
same receiver rejoins discovery with its retained identity and no duplicate enrollment
normal policy restart disables browsing while the verified configured peer remains accessible
